name: Rokurokubi
description: A rokurokubi is a Japanese yōkai that appears nearly human but possesses a neck that stretches to extraordinary lengths; a related subtype called nukekubi has a head that fully detaches and floats independently at night.

aliases.name: 轆轤首
aliases.meaning: pulley neck; neck that extends like a rotating mechanical device

aliases.name: ろくろ首
aliases.meaning: Hiragana form of the same name

aliases.name: Nukekubi
aliases.meaning: detachable head; a related subtype whose head fully separates from the body

regions: All regions of Japan historically; origin traditions also present in China and Southeast Asia
origin: A creature of Japanese folklore, with analogous traditions distributed across East and Southeast Asia, suggesting shared or parallel origin traditions.
